Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Seoul Hero future facility individual PNG artwork.
Primary request: ONE Seoul Hero facility illustration. a sparse 2:1 transparent overlay consisting ONLY of two small matte brass corner caps at the far upper left and upper right, with short pearl streamers and ivory fabric ribbons hanging beside each cap. The middle 65 percent and the entire lower 70 percent are completely empty transparent pixels. No badges, labels, room, architecture, wall, floor, stage, furniture, instruments, enclosing frame or central object. Match the chunky SD urban-fantasy environment language: bold clean outlines, simple painted materials, pale ivory and navy structure with restrained teal/purple/orange indicators. No characters, baked labels, logos, UI frames, buttons or floor shadows on equipment. Clearly separate major silhouettes and retain generous safe margins. Real transparent background and one isolated complete object.
Style: original crisp Korean mobile-game hand-painted raster art, strong readable silhouettes, clean navy outlines where appropriate, restrained cel shading and material highlights. Follow the specific subject palette in the brief. Create a new silhouette and object, with no copied reference subject.
Modern Seoul guild facility artwork. For rooms use orthographic FRONTAL SIDE CUTAWAY, approximately 2:1, consistent horizontal floor height, clear foreground floor for separately overlaid SD employees. No people, HUD, text, buttons or isometric room view. Equipment is a separate transparent cutout, exterior and state follow the supplied subject.
Composition: single subject fully inside canvas, centered with 8 percent safe padding. No contact sheet or multiple examples.
Background: actual transparent RGBA, no opaque backdrop, no fake checkerboard.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark, UI chrome, labels or numbers. Preserve the requested anatomy and view.

Sparse transparent corner overlay ONLY. Two small groups at the upper left and upper right; the center and lower canvas are entirely transparent. Never draw a room, rear wall, architecture, floor, booth, full-width support frame or central object.
